STARLIGHT CHRONICLE

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 24, 2026

Starlight Chronicle is a study-planning game for families. We only use the information needed to provide the game and its optional cloud save feature.

Google Drive cloud saves

If you choose “Sign in with Google”, the game requests access only to your Google Drive appDataFolder. This is a private storage area that other Drive apps and people cannot browse. We store your game profile and progress there so that you can restore it on another device.

We do not read your ordinary Drive files, contacts, email, photos, or any other Google data. You can revoke access at any time from your Google Account security settings.

Information in the game

Game information may include the profile name, learning missions, calendar events, goals, rewards, and progress that you enter. This information stays in your browser unless you choose Google Drive cloud saves.

Children and families

A parent or guardian should manage the family account and any learning information entered for a child.

Contact

For questions about this policy, contact the app administrator through the support email shown on the Google sign-in consent screen.
